notes.title: Get ready to hone your sporting skills on Steam with Super Sports Blast
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6142644/9a45e3e239ddbc6995ef973d60d01e790664d05d.jpg[/img]
Grab a racket, lace up your boots and get ready to spike a few balls on Super Sports Blast! Today we are launching our arcade-packed sports frenzy on Steam, featuring three sports games that can be played in single player or local multiplayer,

Super Sports Blast presents itself as a breakaway from the seriousness of simulation and realism of other complex sports games — whether you are trying to outmaneuver the goalie to win the soccer match or spike your way to volleyball victory.

Challenge your own personalized character against family and friends with an in-depth avatar editor and compete for a spot at the top playing 11-a-side football, Volley and Tennis!

The entire 3-1 experience of Super Sports Blast is priced at $24.99, now with a 20% discount for one week. A perfect game for people to relax and play your favorite sports or even to introduce younger gamers to the sports genre which could well serve up a lot of family fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515740/

notes.title: Easy mode and language update!
notes.notes:
[IMG]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/-p5aW1LV_39I/VWL6h2pE7nI/AAAAAAAAAlg/7vZ6D3iPA2o/w599-h337-no/updateNEW.png[/IMG]

Hi spies!

Happy to announce a new update with some new features and improvements. 


- NEW DIFFICULTY MODE

We heard that some people found the game a bit hard because this game IS hard. That's why we have added a new "normal" difficulty mode that keeps the game challenging and makes it more accessible for every kind of player.

Those who played the game in the original (harder) mode will keep the save with everything. New players will find that a few achievements are only achievable in hard mode.

- 4 NEW LANGUAGES

We just added 4 new languages: French, German, Italian and Spanish.

- SOME MINOR STUFF

We worked a bit on graphics, fixed some bugs and worked on optimization to make the experience cooler and smoother :)
